title: Dark Lips: Causes and How to Lighten Them
h1: Dark lips: what causes them and how to lighten them
desc: Why lips darken, from sun and smoking to genetics and lip products, and how to lighten them with daily care and laser lip tinting from AED 500 + VAT in Dubai.
answer: Lips darken because of sun exposure, smoking, genetics, dehydration, lip licking, allergic reactions to lip products and some medicines. Daily lip SPF and moisture help prevent it, and laser lip tinting (from AED 500 + VAT at Skin & Laser) fades existing pigment gradually for a natural, even tone.
body:
## Daily habits that help

- A lip balm with SPF every day
- Stop licking lips; it dries and darkens them
- Switch to fragrance-free lip products if you react
- Drink enough water
- Stopping smoking

## What laser does

A pigment-targeting laser breaks down extra melanin in the lips. Each session lightens them a little, so the result looks natural rather than bleached.

## When to see a doctor first

Sudden dark patches, a single changing spot, or darkening with other symptoms should be checked by a doctor before any cosmetic treatment.
faq: Do lip scrubs lighten dark lips?
They remove dry skin but don't remove pigment.
Yes, when done with the right laser and settings after a consultation.
Long-term, if you protect lips from sun and avoid smoking.
